_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

910.name: Early Hominids and Prehistory
910.label: Event
910.description: Kenya's Rift Valley as critical site for human evolution; Turkana Boy; Olorgesailie; Koobi Fora fossil beds.

910.name: Turkana Boy and Homo erectus
910.label: Event
910.description: Discovery of Turkana Boy (Nariokotome Boy) near Lake Turkana — most complete Homo erectus skeleton; key to understanding human evolution.

910.name: Koobi Fora and the Leakeys
910.label: Event
910.description: Richard and Meave Leakey's discoveries at Koobi Fora and Lake Turkana; multiple hominid species; stone tool assemblages.

920.name: Swahili Coast Civilisation
920.label: Event
920.description: Rise of Swahili city-states along the Kenyan coast; Mombasa, Lamu, and Malindi as major trading centres; Indian Ocean commerce.

920.name: Early Swahili Settlements
920.label: Event
920.description: Proto-Swahili communities along the coast; iron-working; trade with Arabia and India; Bantu-speaking fishing communities.

920.name: Rise of Mombasa, Lamu, and Malindi
920.label: Event
920.description: Mombasa emerges as major Swahili city-state; Lamu archipelago; coral stone architecture; ivory, gold, and slave trade; Islam as dominant religion.

930.name: Portuguese and Omani Periods
930.label: Event
930.description: Vasco da Gama's arrival; Portuguese Fort Jesus; Omani Arab displacement of Portuguese; Mazrui dynasty in Mombasa.

930.name: Portuguese East Africa
930.label: Event
930.description: Vasco da Gama visits Malindi 1498; Portuguese build Fort Jesus in Mombasa 1593; violent contestation with local sultanates.

930.name: Omani Arab Control
930.label: Event
930.description: Omani siege takes Fort Jesus 1698 after 33-month siege; Mazrui governors establish semi-autonomy in Mombasa; slave trade intensifies.

940.name: British East Africa
940.label: Event
940.description: Imperial British East Africa Company; Uganda Railway; White Highlands settler economy; African resistance and land dispossession.

940.name: IBEAC and the Uganda Railway
940.label: Event
940.description: Imperial British East Africa Company; Berlin Conference allocation; Uganda Railway (Lunatic Express) 1896-1901; Nairobi founded as railway depot.

940.name: White Highlands and Settler Economy
940.label: Event
940.description: European settlers given prime land in White Highlands; Crown Lands Ordinance; coffee and tea plantations; African labour exploitation; kipande pass system.

940.name: Mau Mau Uprising
940.label: Event
940.description: Armed revolt against British colonial rule; state of emergency; detention camps; land and freedom movement.

940.name: Mau Mau Armed Revolt
940.label: Event
940.description: Kikuyu-led revolt for land and freedom; state of emergency declared 1952; Kenyatta detained; forest fighters in Mount Kenya and Aberdares.

940.name: Detention Camps and British Brutality
940.label: Event
940.description: British Pipeline detention system; torture and forced labour; Hola massacre 1959; estimated 11,000+ killed; legacy of land redistribution demands.

950.name: Independence, Kenyatta, and Moi Era
950.label: Event
950.description: Independence under Jomo Kenyatta; harambee nation-building; Daniel arap Moi's authoritarian rule; multi-party transition.

950.name: Independence and Kenyatta Presidency
950.label: Event
950.description: Independence 12 December 1963; Jomo Kenyatta as founding father; harambee philosophy; one-party tendencies; assassination of Tom Mboya and J.M. Kariuki.

950.name: Daniel arap Moi Era
950.label: Event
950.description: Moi succeeds Kenyatta 1978; KANU single-party state; 1982 coup attempt; Nyayo torture chambers; multiparty elections 1992; ethnic clashes.

960.name: Modern Kenya: Democracy and Regional Hub
960.label: Event
960.description: Kibaki era; 2007-08 post-election violence; 2010 constitution; Uhuru Kenyatta; William Ruto; Kenya as East African economic hub.

960.name: Kibaki Presidency and Economic Growth
960.label: Event
960.description: Mwai Kibaki wins 2002; economic reforms; free primary education; infrastructure investment; 2005 constitutional referendum defeat.

960.name: 2007-08 Post-Election Violence
960.label: Event
960.description: Disputed December 2007 election; ~1,500 killed and 600,000 displaced; ethnic violence; Kofi Annan mediation; ICC indictments.
